verdict.rationale: Thoropass's dashboard tracks control counts (total controls, controls with owners) and the Monitors page gives a centralized view of active monitors framed as 'audit readiness,' and the Compliance Roadmap lets you filter/group controls by status per framework — but none of the evidence shows a single consolidated 'percent audit-ready' score per framework combining passing controls and open gaps. missing for 10: an explicit unified readiness percentage metric, gap-count vs passing-count summary, and confirmation it's broken out per framework as one number.
